definition: A line is EXHAUSTED when the next job built directly on this candidate is unlikely to beat this candidate's own search score: its recent changes were knob values without gain, the knobs it varies are already covered in the knob index, its children scored below it, or its card reports a ceiling the change cannot move. A line is OPEN when its card names an untried idea or a mechanism with headroom, its own change gained over its parent, or no job has been built on it yet and its idea is unlike the rest of the population.
levels: exhausted: the next job on it will not beat its score
little headroom: a small gain is possible, a repeat more likely
some headroom: an untried change with a plausible gain exists
much headroom: the card names a mechanism nobody has followed up
